body:
HI @Bhavin1010. You're linking to InstantSearch.js v2 docs. Can you confirm you're using InstantSearch v2?
Here is a working example of priceRanges with InstantSearch.js v2:
https://jsfiddle.net/63saqt5w/10/

If you are indeed using v2, I cannot recommend enough to update: the upgrade guides are sitting here: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/angular/#migration-from-v2-to-v3.

I'll close for now, but if you still have an issue, please do reopen and provide a code sample so I can help troubleshoot.
